parsed.rationale: Both participating records in this cluster carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/AppServices/Tests/AppServicesTests/ReviewRequestServiceTests.swift`. The two methods — `recordRequestSentIncrementsCount` (line 38) and `recordSongAddedToLibraryIncrementsCount` (line 54) — are distinct test cases that verify separate behaviours of `ReviewRequestService` (recording a review request vs. recording a song addition). Their structural similarity (Jaccard 0.75) reflects the natural shape of counter-increment tests, not accidental duplication; each test must remain independently named and independently runnable.
